name: Erbium orthoferrite
equilibrium_context: Canted antiferromagnet with weak ferromagnetism; no static internal field of this kind

driven_states.emergent_property: Nonlinear mode mixing drives not only displacements but rotations of the crystal-field atoms. This acts like an effective magnetic field of order one tesla and excites a spin precession - the first direct demonstration of phono-magnetism.

drive.polarization: linear; the effective field changes sign with the pump polarization
drive.driven_mode: infrared-active Fe-O stretching mode, ionic Raman scattering

driven_states.source: Nova, Cartella, Cantaluppi, Foerst, Bossini, Mikhaylovskiy, Kimel, Merlin & Cavalleri, Nature Physics 13, 132 (2017), doi:10.1038/nphys3925
driven_states.caveat: The effective magnetic field is a descriptive quantity, not a measured field; it is inferred from the amplitude of the spin precession. No magnetic order changes, it is only excited coherently.

threshold.quantity: no threshold, quadratic scaling with the pump amplitude

driven_states.measured_quantity: spin precession in the magneto-optical Kerr effect

sources: Nova et al., Nature Physics 13, 132 (2017), doi:10.1038/nphys3925
gaps: Field strength and fluence not verified.
